biotools.summary: MPRAlib and MPRAsnakeflow are computational tools for uniform processing and analysis of data from Massively Parallel Reporter Assays (MPRAs). They provide standardized formats and robust analysis pipelines to improve data integration, reproducibility, and meta-analyses across studies.
